row.team_price_text: Free (open source, self-hosted; no paid tiers)
row.evidence: Apache Superset is free open-source software ("open source under the Apache 2.0 license"); its docs cover OAuth2, LDAP and self-registration of users on login, plus a beta Flask-AppBuilder user CRUD API, but no SCIM endpoint.
row.notes: New row. Apache Superset is an Apache Software Foundation open-source project with no vendor, pricing page or paid tier (hosted commercial Superset is sold separately by Preset, not researched here), so team and price fields are null or zero. No SCIM is documented (none by absence across the docs sitemap of about 1,900 pages, the security and configuration guides, the API reference and the FAQ). Sign-in uses Flask-AppBuilder: OAuth2 against any 'code'-flow authorization server (Okta, Entra/Azure, Google and others), LDAP, with AUTH_USER_REGISTRATION creating users on first login and AUTH_ROLES_MAPPING/AUTH_ROLES_SYNC_AT_LOGIN mapping IdP groups to roles. A beta REST API (/api/v1/security/users, /roles, /groups) is off by default and is enabled with FAB_ADD_SECURITY_API = True. No IdP catalogue app was found.

plans.name: Open source (self-hosted)
plans.notes: No paid tiers. SSO is OAuth2/OIDC-style 'code' flow or LDAP configured in superset_config.py.

scim.notes: Not available by absence: no SCIM page in the docs sitemap; user management is via FAB auth backends and the beta security REST API.

auth.notes: API keys are off by default (FAB_API_KEY_ENABLED).

endpoints.purpose: End a user's sessions (documented for the next, unreleased version)
Set a role's users (documented for the next, unreleased version)

limitations.text: The security (user CRUD) API is beta and disabled by default; enable with FAB_ADD_SECURITY_API = True.

fallbacks.other_sync: LDAP authentication with AUTH_ROLES_MAPPING group-to-role sync at login
fallbacks.notes: jit_protocol 'oidc' stands for the OAuth2 'code' flow; LDAP logins also self-register when AUTH_USER_REGISTRATION is on.
